plan.reason: At 24/100 evaluations with stagnation 20 and zero recent improvement, the objective appears flat or noisy locally; boosting exploration to 0.5 and local_fraction to 0.5 balances surrogate-guided refinement with novelty-driven sampling to escape stagnation. Auto surrogate chooses RBF or quadratic by held-out RMSE, robust when data is sparse (5-D, 24 samples). current_to_best DE with moderate mutation 0.6 and crossover 0.7 provides balanced convergence/diversity; population 30 and 8 generations keep surrogate-assisted steps affordable within the fixed budget without extra true evaluations.

At 44/100 evaluations with 13-step stagnation and zero recent improvement, the search is stuck; raising exploration to 0.7 and widening radius to 0.2 encourages novelty-driven escape while retaining surrogate ranking. Auto surrogate adapts RBF/quadratic to sparse 5-D data under high CV error (0.54), so predictions are unreliable; current_to_best DE with higher mutation 0.7 and crossover 0.8 maintains diversity, moderate local_fraction 0.4 balances refinement and global sampling, and population 28 with 6 generations keeps surrogate cost affordable within the fixed budget.

5-D problem is mid-budget (64/100) with 7-step stagnation but modest recent improvement (4%), and CV error 0.73 signals unreliable surrogate predictions, so lean on novelty-weighted exploration (0.9) and a wider radius (0.25) to escape local basins. Auto surrogate adapts RBF vs quadratic to sparse data; current_to_best DE balances convergence and diversity, with elevated mutation (0.9) and crossover (0.85) to avoid premature collapse. Moderate local_fraction (0.35) still allows refinement, while population 32 and 7 generations keep surrogate fitting cost modest within the fixed budget.

With 84/100 evaluations used, only ~16 true evaluations remain, so the rest of the budget must be spent on well-targeted candidates rather than broad search. Stagnation is high (27) and recent improvement is zero, indicating a local basin, while CV normalized RMSE 0.81 shows the surrogate is unreliable and should not be trusted for fine-grained exploitation. Therefore raise exploration (1.2) and radius (0.3) to emphasize novelty and escape the basin, lower local_fraction (0.2) to avoid wasting the few remaining evaluations on over-trusted local refinement, and keep auto surrogate to adapt between RBF and quadratic on sparse data. current_to_best with elevated mutation (1.1) and crossover (0.9) preserves diversity under a small population (28) and 6 generations, keeping surrogate fitting cheap within the fixed budget.
